slot.brief: Evaluate a limit of a telescoping product or a rational function after factorisation and cancellation.

verdicts.working: Factor x^4−1=(x−1)(x+1)(x²+1) and x³−1=(x−1)(x²+x+1). Cancel x−1 and substitute x=1 to get 4/3.

working:

$\displaystyle\lim_{x\to1}\frac{(x+1)(x^2+1)}{x^2+x+1}=\frac43$
